title: Integral finite restriction coefficient diagram
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and its finite subfields $A$ with their small coefficient models $E_A$ [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. For schemes $X,Y,s$ and maps $f:X\to Y$, $y:s\to Y$, use the specified strict-sequence inverse images, direct images, exchange mate and tuple of point counits [lem-zl-finite-counit-restriction-towers]. Apply simultaneous strict derived reduction [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], total right derivation and the whole-system derived limit to obtain the three ambient functors (source, middle, point target) and the two actual natural transformations. An integral diagram records their preservation of the integral constructible subcategories [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]; its functors and arrows are the literal full-subcategory restrictions. An integral comparison family consists of one such diagram at every $A$ and natural isomorphisms $F_A C_{B/A,s}\simeq C_{B/A,X}F_B$ for every inclusion and each of the three vertices. Here scalar change and its unit and balanced associator are the prescribed ones [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition]. Its law predicate is the multiplication-unit equation and the two actual arrow squares. Its coherence predicate is the equality between the successive comparison followed by the source balanced associator and the target balanced associator followed by the direct comparison for every triple $A\subset B\subset C$.
